fields.description: Original settlement document from which this amended record was created.
fields.label: Amended From

fields.description: Reconciliation run that created or controls this settlement.
fields.label: Brokerage Reconciliation

fields.description: Date on which this policy-statement allocation or write-off is recorded.
fields.label: Settlement Date

fields.description: Type of settlement, such as normal allocation, write-off, adjustment, or reversal.
fields.label: Settlement Type

fields.description: Matching rule that found this policy-statement pair.
fields.label: Match Method
fields.options:
Exact Policy Number
Formatted Policy Number
Policy and Customer
Customer and Dates
Manual

fields.description: Confidence score of the matching rule; exact matches use 100.
fields.label: Match Score

fields.description: Submitted Policy Register receivable that is being settled.
fields.label: Policy Register

fields.description: Submitted Brokerage Statement receipt used for allocation. It may be blank for pure write-off cases.
fields.label: Brokerage Statement

fields.description: Original settlement that this reversal is intended to cancel.
fields.label: Reverses Settlement

fields.description: Snapshot of the policy expected brokerage when this settlement is validated.
fields.label: Policy Expected Amount

fields.description: Snapshot of policy outstanding brokerage before this settlement is submitted.
fields.label: Policy Outstanding Before

fields.description: Snapshot of total brokerage received on the statement before this settlement is submitted.
fields.label: Statement Received Amount

fields.description: Snapshot of statement unallocated brokerage before this settlement is submitted.
fields.label: Statement Unallocated Before

fields.description: Amount from the statement that is allocated against the policy receivable.
fields.label: Allocated Amount

fields.description: Policy balance closed without receipt, usually for approved small differences.
fields.label: Write-off Amount

fields.description: Remaining policy difference after allocated and write-off amounts are applied.
fields.label: Difference Amount

fields.description: Reason or note for the settlement. Required when a write-off amount is entered.
fields.label: Remarks
